hook: Your commute in La Paz, Bolivia can be a cable car.
title: Your Commute Here Is a Cable Car
description:
In La Paz, Bolivia, ordinary commuters ride cable cars to work. The Mi Teleférico network is one of the largest urban cable car systems in the world. Its lines are named after colours.

#Shorts #Bolivia #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you ride it? Yes or no
